title: PLM Test Case Scene Classification Rules
description: Defines how test cases from this program are classified into PLM's 3-level scene hierarchy (L1=Language → L2=Model → L3=Interface). An agent reading this file can automatically determine the correct scene for any new test case.

L3.description: Interface type classification by method name keyword matching. Rules are applied in priority order — first match wins.

rules.name: 异常/校验
rules.description: Exception handling, error validation, boundary checks, conflict detection

rules.name: 写入接口
rules.description: Data writing, tablet operations, writer/builder APIs

rules.name: 查询接口
rules.description: Data querying, reading, filtering, selection operations

rules.name: Schema/Metadata
rules.description: Schema definition, metadata inspection, column management

rules.name: 查询接口
rules.description: Default fallback — any case not matching above rules

sceneBinding.note: PAT token requires READ,WRITE scopes. Scene IDs can be queried via GET /api/open/scenes?productId={productId}.

usage.byAgent: Read this file to understand the 3-level classification. For each test case from list-cases --json, determine L2 by sourceFile path, then L3 by applying L3 rules in priority order to the caseId (lowercased). Use Open API to create scenes and bind cases.
